scope: Pre-recorded top-down drone clips from Pexels illustrate a synthetic logistics scenario. None was filmed at the fictional CA-47 incident or near the Port of Los Angeles or Long Beach.
annotation_method: Road regions and visual notes drawn by AI-assisted review of the keyframe; provisional, not independently validated ground truth.

summary.interpretation: A demonstration on hand-picked clips, not an accuracy measurement.

cases.title: Truck crash across travel lanes
cases.review_note: A jackknifed tractor-trailer and spilled load lie across the marked carriageway, with a second truck stopped beside it. No traffic passes the wreck in this direction. The opposite carriageway, outside the marked region, keeps moving.
cases.annotation_method: Road regions and visual notes drawn by AI-assisted review of the keyframe; provisional, not independently validated ground truth.

cv_assessment.reason: 1 vehicle(s) standing still and 1 crawling under 10 km/h, of 2 on the marked road; nothing moves through
cv_assessment.basis: Unvalidated rule: hand-set speed thresholds, approximate speeds from an assumed 2 m vehicle width, no labelled blockage footage to score it against. A dispatcher confirms or overrides it.

cases.title: Same crash, closer pass
cases.review_note: The wrecked cab, its trailer and a fuel or fluid spill cover the marked carriageway, which is otherwise empty. Traffic on the far carriageway, outside the marked region, is moving. The detector does not recognise the jackknifed wreck as a vehicle, so the CV sees an empty road and stays inconclusive; the dispatcher can see the wreck and override it. The camera turns during the clip; the road region follows it.
